description: What is in the local imports folder made by import_workouts (~/.suunto-mcp/imported/, SUUNTO_IMPORT_DIR moves it), from the folder alone: { dir, imported (workouts whose record and file check out), bySource: { garmin?, strava?, apple?, other? }, bytes, oldest, newest (UTC dates of the imported workouts), problems: [{ id, problem }] (a damaged, foreign or newer record, a missing file, a file whose size differs from its record: never repaired or deleted), incomplete: [{ id, problem }] (a file with no record, left by an interrupted import_workouts: not counted; importing the same file again completes it), otherFiles (files in the folder that are not part of the imports, never touched), notes }. A file is checked by its size against its record, not read again or re-hashed. A folder that does not exist is an empty store and is not created. Local files only: never contacts Suunto, needs no Suunto credentials, writes nothing. In demo mode it describes the in-memory store. Read-only.
name: get_import_status
title: Get the local imported-workouts status
